coverage_exempt.reason: Original 4bf6e8..4bf6f5 sets change iff depth !=8; no calls or writes alter depth/change before 4bf757. Reaching 4bf75c requires change nonzero and depth8 simultaneously, so no permitted input reaches this branch.

Original 4bef50 returns zero only for null output or input. Caller 4bf798 excludes null allocated output; input is readable PID data+32 following earlier header reads and cannot be null within backed guest address space. It otherwise returns one or faults, never zero; no fixture replaces this callee.

limits: Operator new and malloc use the comparison allocator instead of the Windows heap.
Operator delete uses the comparison release service instead of the Windows heap.
Windows diagnostic imports 0x546ca4 and 0x546d48 return zero without sound or a dialog.
DirectDraw and receiver virtual services are case-supplied physical or callback boundaries; game callees remain original-backed.
Cases use cached resource bytes and disabled diagnostic logging to avoid unrelated file and formatting service paths.
Legacy native exports remain in the existing source and header; this canonical module adds a separate dispatch entry.
